Dylan / Monica —

Thanks for the summary. I'm comfortable ratifying the objective set with two edits to KR4 (operational):
1) Add an "auto-fallback" SLA clause: during peak fallback events, we accept up to 180s degraded throughput for non-enterprise tiers but must maintain 99.5% availability for committed routes.
2) Add a rollback window of 30 minutes for any model rollout that changes production quantization settings; ops must be able to revert to prior quantized artifacts within that window.

With those guardrails added to the canvas, I approve. I will work with infra to bake the language into the QBR appendix and update JIRA INF-4823.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure & Reliability
